articles.title: Akasa Air appoints ex-Dish TV executive Abhishek Gupta as CIO
articles.summary: Akasa Air has appointed Abhishek Gupta as its new Chief Information Officer. Gupta previously served as Corporate Head of IT at Dish TV for several years. He brings over two decades of experience in IT architecture and digital strategy. His expertise includes IT modernization, cloud adoption, and AI deployment. Gupta expressed gratitude for his time and colleagues at Dish TV.

articles.title: Embassy Developments gains on Rs 711 crore residential tower deal
articles.summary: Embassy Developments rose 1.03% to Rs 59.59 after the company said that it has signed a pact for the sale of an entire residential tower at its Embassy Terazza project in Juhu, Mumbai, for approximately Rs 711 crore.

articles.title: Parag Milk Foods gains on plan to quadruple paneer capacity to 80 MT/day
articles.summary: Parag Milk Foods advanced 1.14% to Rs 273.70 after the company announced plans to quadruple its paneer manufacturing capacity from existing 20 MT per day to 80 MT per day.

articles.title: Fredun Pharmaceuticals acquires 26% stake in Goodman Vetcare
articles.summary: Fredun Pharmaceuticals has acquired a 26% stake in Goodman Vetcare marking a strategic step towards strengthening its presence in India's animal health, veterinary retail and pet-care market. The association brings together Goodman's deep expertise and established retail network with Fredun Pharmaceuticals's capabilities across healthcare, manufacturing, pet-care brands, technology and business development, creating a strong foundation for the next phase of growth. Together, the businesses will focus on expanding the brand's footprint into new geographies while gradually strengthening its omnichannel capabilities.

articles.title: Global Market: Bank of Korea signals data-driven approach to further rate hikes
articles.summary: Bank of Korea board member Chang Yong-sung signaled a data-driven approach to future interest rate hikes, emphasizing inflation, economic growth, and financial stability. The remarks follow the central bank's recent 25 basis point rate hike to 3.00% on August 27 as policymakers act to contain financial imbalances.

articles.summary: Polycab shares have fallen 17% from their June peak after UltraTech entered the wires and cables segment. Jefferies retained its Buy rating and Rs 11,100 target, implying 33% upside, citing strong demand, volume growth and Polycab’s distribution strength.

articles.title: India’s oil buyers may cut Russia cargoes as US risk rises
articles.summary: Indian refiners may reduce Russian crude imports amid new US sanctions.  This move comes as the US legislation allows tariffs on countries buying Russian oil.  India has previously adjusted its Russian oil purchases based on US pressure.  The nation seeks affordable energy for its large population.  Future buying cycles will occur during this period of uncertainty.

articles.title: Global Market: Ligent Technologies jumps 19% in Hong Kong listing debut
articles.summary: Ligent Technologies shares surged nearly 19% in their Hong Kong debut after the Chinese fibre-optic communications equipment maker raised HK$5.67 billion through its IPO. The stock opened above its offer price and gained further before paring back some gains. Strong retail and institutional demand drove the closely watched listing debut.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs raises target on a stock that has already surged over 140% this year. Do you own it?
articles.summary: Sansera Engineering shares rallied after Goldman Sachs raised its target price to Rs 4,990 from Rs 4,500 while retaining its Buy rating. The revised target implies 16.1% upside, with the stock already up over 140% in 2026. Goldman sees investments by Applied Materials and Lam Research in India supporting local supplier ecosystems and R&D, potentially driving longer-term growth for Sansera’s ADS component business.

articles.title: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy surges after bagging orders worth Rs 985 crore
